resources.name: Crystal structure of SrNbO2N (I4/mcm space group)

access.notes: Parent I4/mcm structure from literature (Ebbinghaus et al. 2004). Also available from Materials Project or ICSD.

resources.notes: Used as the starting geometry for N substitutions. Atomic positions can be generated from space group 140 with published lattice parameters.

resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO) with PBEsol GGA and PAW pseudopotentials

access.notes: Alternatives: ABINIT, GPAW. Must support DFT+U with Liechtenstein rotationally invariant scheme and PBEsol functional.

resources.notes: Provides the DFT engine for geometry optimization, magnetic total energy calculations, and double-well energy scans.

resources.name: SOD (Site Occupation Disorder) code (optional)

access.notes: Can be used to generate disordered O/N configurations, but manual substitution or a simple script is also adequate.

resources.notes: Not strictly necessary; agent can manually replace O atoms by N to achieve target compositions.
